posts.headline: Forty-seven editions and counting — Klint's Clipboard is 6-2 but 934.5 points-for is still the lightest scoring total of any six-win team wearing a ring in this league's history.
posts.detail: Thicks has a title and a 14-14 career record to prove it means something, but a 5.5 average finish says the hype has never matched the hardware, and this season's point total isn't closing that gap.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers are the best team in Busters Anonymous and nobody wants to admit it out loud anymore.
posts.detail: triciagloston's 1128.92 points-for is the top mark in the league at 6-2, and a one-season 6-7-1 pedigree means she's rewriting her own résumé in real time.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's Put it in Ra is now a cautionary tale taught in future draft rooms.
posts.detail: A career 20-8 record and the best-ever 1.5 average finish in league history has cratered to 2-6 at 874.16 points, and the free fall shows zero signs of stopping.

posts.headline: Chauncey's talentedtenthh is still the worst product on the board at 1-7.
posts.detail: 798.32 points-for and a career 12-average-finish résumé confirm the name was never ironic — it's a prophecy fulfilling itself week after week.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT is 0-8 and Eli's Ultimate Light Skin has officially become this league's Book of Job.
posts.detail: A 13-14-1 career record says he's usually mediocre, not historically cursed, which makes this winless stretch at 874.99 points feel like a plague sent specifically to humble the man who once drafted a defender first overall.
